page_title: NEW 3-0 WOL | Newcastle v Wolves 02/03/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The match has just finished.
90+3' Substitution. Anthony Gordon will be replaced by Elliot Anderson (Newcastle Utd).
90+2' 3 - 0 Valentino Livramento (Newcastle Utd) makes a great solo run and pulls the trigger from inside the box, beating Daniel Bentley with a strike into the bottom left corner. He makes it 3:0.
90+2' Nathan Fraser (Wolves) meets a cross inside the box, but Martin Dubravka wins the battle for the ball and the chance is gone.
90+1' 5 additional min. will be played.
90' Martin Dubravka leaps to intercept the corner kick from Pablo Sarabia (Wolves).
89' Pablo Sarabia (Wolves) wastes a golden opportunity inside the box by shooting straight into the back of an opponent when the goal was at his mercy. Good work from Wolves as they win a corner.
89' Bruno Guimaraes (Newcastle Utd) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.

87' Max Kilman (Wolves) takes a snap shot from the edge of the box after a rebound, but his effort is a waste as it goes high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Newcastle.
85' Rayan Ait-Nouri (Wolves) sees a yellow! His tackle wasn't that harsh, but he probably talked himself into Tim Robinson's book.
81' Gary O'Neil prepares a substitution. Jean-Ricner Bellegarde is replaced by Tawanda Chirewa (Wolves).
81' It will be a substitution. Boubacar Traore (Wolves) is ready to enter the pitch as Mario Lemina walks off.

79' Miguel Almiron (Newcastle Utd) anticipates the lofted pass and races into the box with just the keeper to beat. He shoots early towards the bottom right corner, but Jose Sa pulls off a great save to deny him. The referee points to the corner flag and Newcastle will take a corner.
78' Bruno Guimaraes (Newcastle Utd) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.

77' Newcastle are just stroking the ball across the park now, but the defence is doing very well breaking up their possession. The ball is out of play. Newcastle will have a chance to score from a corner.
77' Sean Longstaff (Newcastle Utd) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.

73' Jean-Ricner Bellegarde (Wolves) rises above the opponent's defence and heads a precise cross towards the middle of the goal. His effort, however, is blocked by Martin Dubravka, who pulls off a comfortable save!
73' Rough tackle by Sven Botman (Newcastle Utd). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
72' Lewis Miley (Newcastle Utd) meets a cross inside the box, but Jose Sa wins the battle for the ball and the chance is gone.
70' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Lewis Miley (Newcastle Utd) is coming onto the pitch as Joe Willock cannot continue after picking up an injury.
70' Eddie Howe has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Miguel Almiron (Newcastle Utd) replacing Jacob Murphy.
70' The referee signals a substitution. Harvey Barnes (Newcastle Utd) is brought on as a substitute for Alexander Isak.
69' Pablo Sarabia (Wolves) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
69' Pablo Sarabia (Wolves) takes the corner but it's cleared.

68' Pablo Sarabia (Wolves) latches on to a lovely pass inside the box and fires towards the right side of the net, but the effort is smothered by the keeper. The linesman makes the right call and Wolves will have a corner.
68' Wolves enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
66' Nathan Fraser (Wolves) fashions a shot from the edge of the box after receiving an accurate pass. Martin Dubravka makes a stunning save to stop the effort from flying into the bottom left corner.
64' Alexander Isak (Newcastle Utd) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
63' Nathan Fraser (Wolves) meets a cross inside the box, but Martin Dubravka wins the battle for the ball and the chance is gone.
60' Today's match ends for Toti who will be replaced by Hugo Bueno (Wolves).
57' The corner is swung in but Newcastle can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

56' Joe Willock (Newcastle Utd) plants a goal-bound header towards the bottom right corner after a nice cross inside the box, but one of the defenders manages to deflect it away. The ball goes out for a corner. Newcastle can continue in their attacking effort.
52' Eddie Howe is forced to make a change. Kieran Trippier is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Valentino Livramento (Newcastle Utd).
50' Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
46' Gary O'Neil has decided to substitute Jose Sa and he is replaced by Daniel Bentley (Wolves).
46' Substitution. Nathan Fraser (Wolves) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Pedro Neto walks off.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+4' Tim Robinson has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+2' Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
45' We will have 3 min. of added time.
44' Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) received a clever through ball which could have put him in a promising position, but the defence was alert to the danger.
41' Bruno Guimaraes (Newcastle Utd) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
39' Pedro Neto (Wolves) is caught offside by the linesman and it looks like it is the right decision despite being a very close call.

36' The keeper doesn't have to worry about this one. Jacob Murphy (Newcastle Utd) sacrificed accuracy for power, and thus his attempt went well over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Wolves.
35' Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.
33' 2 - 0 Goal! Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) seizes on the loose ball after a huge error from Jose Sa and finds the back of the net from inside the box. 2:0.
32' Jacob Murphy (Newcastle Utd) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
32' The referee blows his whistle for a foul after Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd) overruns the ball during an attack and makes an aggressive challenge on his opponent.
30' It's a nice effort by Jacob Murphy (Newcastle Utd) from the edge of the box, but it's low towards the middle of the goal and straight down the throat of Jose Sa. Easy save.
28' Wolves quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
27' Nelson Semedo (Wolves) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders. Wolves force a corner. They send men into the box.
25' Alexander Isak (Newcastle Utd) unleashes a shot from the edge of the box, but it goes straight at Jose Sa.
24' Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd) is unable to get the free-kick over the defensive wall from mid-range.
24' Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd) is going to send the ball in from the free kick.

22' Toti (Wolves) times his run and jump perfectly to get on the end of the resulting corner, but the ball comes off the top of his head and goes miles over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Newcastle will have a goal kick.
21' Pablo Sarabia (Wolves) will take a corner kick.
21' Pedro Neto (Wolves) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. Wolves will take a corner kick.

19' Dan Burn (Newcastle Utd) finds himself with a great opportunity! He unleashes a shot from the edge of the box, which whizzes just wide of the right post! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Wolves.
17' Pablo Sarabia (Wolves) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender.
17' Martin Dubravka displays his ability to read the game and clears the danger after Toti (Wolves) threatened to latch onto a through ball from just outside the box.
14' 1 - 0 Alexander Isak (Newcastle Utd) gets to the rebound inside the six-yard box and produces a header. He manages to put the ball inside the right post and makes it 1:0.
13' A long ball forward to Pedro Neto (Wolves) is intercepted.
11' The players claim that Jean-Ricner Bellegarde (Wolves) handled the ball and it seems they are right.
9' Rayan Ait-Nouri (Wolves) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
7' Wolves take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
3' Jean-Ricner Bellegarde (Wolves) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
1' Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
The players are out and the match is about to start. Newcastle will have the kick-off.
Tim Robinson will referee today's match.
